english.title: Possess an extreme pornographic image / images portraying rape
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) possessed

(A)_[an extreme pornographic image]_
(B)_[extreme pornographic images, namely **(..SPECIFY NUMBER OF IMAGES..),]_

which portrayed in an explicit and realistic way an act which involved the non-consensual penetration of a person's vagina, anus or mouth by another with the other person's penis and a reasonable person looking at the image would think that the persons were real
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 63(1), (7A)(a) and 67(2) of the Criminal Justice and Immigration Act 2008.

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
